title: SlopeCheckResponse
description: Result of a server-side slope check on the full-resolution DEM. A 'pass' means the DEM-scale slope criterion holds; it is NOT a validated landing site (boulders and sub-pixel craters are invisible at 20 m).

status.description: 'computed' = stats are real. 'out_of_coverage' = zone not fully inside the DEM. 'dem_unavailable' = the service has no DEM loaded.

verdict.description: 'pass'/'fail' only when status = computed. 'insufficient_data' when no-data fraction exceeds max_nodata_fraction.

request.description: Echo of the validated request, with defaults filled in.

pixel_count.description: DEM pixels whose centre lies inside the zone.

nodata_count.description: Pixels without a valid slope (DEM no-data or no-data neighbour).

fraction_ok.description: Fraction of valid pixels with slope <= max_slope_deg.

worst_pixel.description: Location of the steepest valid pixel, to highlight in the UI.

baseline_m.description: Horizontal scale of the slope estimate, meters. null only when status = dem_unavailable (no DEM to describe).

body_fixed_frame.description: DEM label COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME. null only when status = dem_unavailable.
